rotation: original RGB canvas, OpenCV linear, BORDER_REFLECT_101
selection: minimum descriptor MSE over actual K references and 8 rotations
reference_shape_fallback: INTER_CUBIC resize to query shape if processed shapes differ
alignment: ECC Euclidean; warp selected reference into unchanged query coordinates
image_score: mean of largest floor(1 percent * input_map_pixel_count), at least 1
native_map: OpenCV INTER_LINEAR to original image height/width
mask_processing: unchanged original GT, normal GT all zeros
parameter_selection: fixed geometric settings before formal ECC test outcomes; synthetic registration checks only
ecc_acceptance: finite bounded transform, sufficient overlap, nondecreasing valid-pixel grayscale correlation
ecc_border: outside valid warped-reference support, retain unaligned reference; never copy query or zero error
ecc_fallback: original unaligned selected reference, explicit reason logged
map_storage: native float32 npy, identical-SHA256 hardlinks after timed inference; no quantization or score changes
